name: Inui Komako
source: A second-year student attending the island's high school, as well as [url=/c52251]Yuno's[/url] classmate and friend. She is a mature girl who fights against the monsters that appear on the island, and ends up saving [url=/c55893]Kouichi[/url] after he gets attacked by one. She wears her school uniform even during her summer vacation because of the "school's rules".
